name: real-wizard
covers: a short Loop 1 as the Wizard

recentLog.text: A low, resonant hum vibrates under your skin, as if the stones are breathing.
A whisper slips through the archway: 'Wayfinder... follow.'
The scorch-hand on the wall is at the height of your own. You do not put yours in it.
The growl ahead stops when you stop. It starts when you start.
The growl ahead was never a growl. Something steps out of the wall.
You read the Dark Spellbook.
You take 15 damage.
A cold gust rattles the shelves, and you smell old ink and rain.
A page turns itself on a shelf that no longer exists. You read one word before it is gone: 'Conflux.'
Light knots itself between two shelves and turns toward you.

Collapsed shelves form jagged ridges of splintered wood and stone. Dust motes swirl in a dim glow, and you can almost hear pages turning on their own. In an alcove behind the fallen stacks, something small and bright waits in a cradle of stone.
Looking closer, you find something.
A submerged page unfurls, whispering of the Ley Line Conflux.
On the top step of the drowned stair sits a lantern etched with glyphs. The water below it is black, not dark.
In the carrel under the east stair a sodden figure clutches a scroll and turns her back to you.
Magic +1 for the rest of this loop.
The Heartstone answers your presence with a tremor that shakes dust from the ceiling.
Light fractures into false paths, then snaps back into focus.
In the cleft a man in a Wayfinder's coat raises a hand. He is gone before it finishes rising.
The path doubles. One of the two has teeth.
The spires throb in unison, a slow heartbeat of raw arcana.
A strand of light unspools from the nearest spire and turns toward you.
Three grey wings settle on the rock, waiting for a bare wrist.
You find a name you know on the wall. DANTHE. Below it, smaller: and her daughter.
Two pale figures stand on the rim, each holding a lamp that has not been lit in a hundred years.
Pellam pours you something hot without asking. 'The bell rang twice last night,' he says. 'It never rings twice.'
You buy Brine Draught for 20 gold.
You buy Brine Draught for 20 gold.
You buy Brine Draught for 20 gold.
A ledger lists the drowned by street. The last entry is in a different hand: 'and the Warden of Waters, by her own choice.'
A clerk in a drowned coat looks up from the ledger. Beside it a reader keeps its place with a wet finger.
The lamps under the water do not flicker. Someone tends them.
Two pale shapes uncoil from the lamp-posts under the water.
A pen scratches in the next row. Then it stops, at your name.
The hand on the pages is Oriel Danthe's. You know it from a scroll you carried to a woman with the same hand.
Around the lectern the drowned stand in a ring and read one name aloud.
You read the Oriel's Ledger.
The Warden lifts its head. 'Is it the hour?' it asks, in the voice of a city.
You read the Rhune's Hydromancy.
Something inside the bell takes up its rope. Beside the shell a reader opens a book.
The current wants you west. Something in the west wants you too.
Three pale shapes uncurl from the eddies where the grates have rusted through.
You crush a leaf without meaning to. The smell is clean. Nothing here has been clean in a long time.
A shape between the trunks keeps your pace for ten steps, then is a tree.
Two shapes pace you through the fog, one on each side of the trail.
You gather Ley Resin.
You gather Rootbone.
Hammer strikes ring out like a steady heartbeat.
A cutting gale whips through the peaks, carrying flecks of stone.
At the end of the path worn into the scree, roots and bone rise to meet you.
The Brute's den is a nest of roots and old steel. Nomad steel. It has been eating patrols.
Stone scrapes stone as something massive shifts in the dark.
Two slate figures stand in the drag furrows, turned to face outward.
Max HP +15 for the rest of this loop.
You gather Ley Resin.
You gather Rootbone.
The stream's soft rush quiets the chaos in your thoughts.
Kaelen looks east toward the camp for a long moment, then does not.
You buy Mana Bloom for 23 gold.
You buy Steppe Salt for 4 gold.
You gather Ley Resin.
You gather Rootbone.
Wild magic surges. A chorus of distant bells rings out, then fades.
A knot of light lifts off the fountain's rim.
A low hum rises from the abyss, vibrating with hungry intent.
Behind you the rope bridge sways and settles. It held. Your feet will remember which boards took your weight.
The air tastes of ash and frost. Something in the hollow hisses your name.
The curtain of dark at the hollow's edge has a seam. Two figures in grey thread stand either side of it and do not look at you.
Two shapes pull loose from the scree, eyes like cold stars.
Brak will not walk with Nyx at his back. "Not her. Not behind me." He goes back to the Camp to wait.
A third comes down the slope behind them, unhurried.
'Eight,' says one sentry to the other as you pass. You do not ask eight of what.
Two lanterns drift out of the curtain. Their glass is lit with dark.
The thread along the wall is warm. Someone is holding the other end.
Halfway down, the wall opens a mouth where the thread ends.
You buy Chronal Dust for 19 gold.
A Weaver picks a hole from a branch and eats it. Afterward there is slightly less of her, and she looks pleased.
Between two trees that are not there, two mouths with no heads turn toward the sound of your breathing.
You lose 9 HP.

The Hollow below and the Veil above overlap like two pages held to the light. The seam between them is a woman's height.
Two shapes come over the lip of the ledge, eyes like cold stars.
At the far end of the gallery your reflection is waiting for you. It arrived first.
